decisionsTitle: Every email a staff press sends carries its press, «Emailuri azi» lists the day's emails, every press names its email before and the toast after the press says what it emailed, and «Trimite emailul» lets the person's own email stay unsent
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-11-03** (his four choices, as the design «telling the owner about every email a staff press sends» records them): every staff press that sends an email should say so before the press, say after it what left and when, let him untick the person's email where that is sensible, and there should be one list of every email of the day. The design builds it in four slices on one backbone; this branch carries them, each slice adding its decisions here.

**Slice 1 — the backbone and the day's list.**

- **Every row says what queued it.** Two columns on `email_outbox`, expand only (migration `0189_email_press`): `cause`, a closed token of the press or the job (`notifications/domain/press-causes.ts`: `registrations.cancel`, `volunteers.assign`, `job.registrationMaintenance`, … with the main emails each press sends the person it acts on, for the toast of slice 2), and `press_id`, one id per press or job run shared by every row it queued — the person's message, the club's copies, an offer to the next in line. Neither holds personal data. `requested_by_staff_user_id` is now filled by every staff press (a requester the service names still wins); only the manual-resend history reads it, so nothing on screen changes.
- **The email press scope** (`notifications/press.ts`): every emailing Server Action of the design's list — 44 presses across registrations, events, volunteers and the club — wraps its whole body in `inEmailPress("<cause>", …)` and names its actor with `press.by(actor.id)` right after its staff check; the two job routes open the jobs' scopes, and so do the drains that do the outbox job's work after a response (Next's `after()` carries a request's async scopes into its callback, and a road's notice queued there is the job's, never the press's). `AsyncLocalStorage`, part of Node — no new dependency — rather than React's per-request `cache`, which the road choice already hedges may not hold in a Server Action. A public flow opens none: its rows read «de pe site». `enqueueEmail`, the club's copies (per message and per bulk send) and the relay stamp each row from the scope; the scope labels rows and never decides whether or when one leaves. Presses that queue nothing themselves open none: «Trimite acum», publishing (the job queues the alerts under its own scope), Zitadel's password link, the timing and road settings. `tests/unit/shared/emailing-presses.test.ts` holds every listed press to its scope and its actor, refuses a scope in an unlisted action or on a public flow; `tests/e2e/email-journal.spec.ts` runs one press, «Anulează înscrierea», through Next itself and reads the stamps back, and the press on «Emailuri azi».
- **One judgement of when a waiting email leaves** (`notifications/domain/departure.ts#departureOf`, moved from the queue panel): the queue, «Emailuri azi» and the toast of slice 2 ask it. Two things it says that the queue did not: «Pleacă după ce Mailgun reia: HH:MM (estimat).» for a Mailgun-road row while Mailgun is stopped and nothing carries it, or while a Free plan's day is spent; and «Pleacă acum» for a row the «imediat» timing's drain is still sending (queued a moment ago, never tried). The second is judged after the first: that drain's claim takes no Mailgun-road row while Mailgun is stopped and nothing carries it, and a spent Free day's refusal defers the row to the reset, so such a row says when Mailgun reopens, never «acum» — for up to five minutes the queue and the day's list would otherwise promise what waits for the reopening. A press's own «Trimite acum» (§540) stays «acum» even then: it is asked only with room to send. The late judgement is health's, unchanged.
- **«Emailuri azi»** (`/admin/settings/emails/today`, «Setări» → «Emailuri» stays marked): every email of the club's day — left since midnight on the club's clock, waiting from any day, failed or refused today — with the person's name and address, in two sections, «Așteaptă acum» then «Au plecat azi», one row per press with its moment, its cause in words and who pressed («automat: …» for a job, «De pe site» for a row no press queued). The name comes from the registration, the volunteer's row (the parent's on the parent's link) or the colleague's account found by its canonical address. The club's own mailboxes — a copy, the declaration's archive, «cineva a confirmat» — fold under the message they copy or under their press, by the audience map (Critic correction 4), never counted as people. More than five lines of one email in one press fold behind one line that says how many. Never the payload's words, a body, a link or a provider's detail beyond a failed row's sanitized reason; capped at 2000 rows with «Și încă N».
- **The "am I sending too much" signal** (Critic correction 5, which overrides the design's "three or more emails today"): three emails is the ordinary registration journey, so the warning at the top lists only **the same email to the same person twice or more today**, counted by the canonical address (AGENTS.md §10.4, never a raw compare) on the person's own mail — never the club's or a colleague's notices — and on real rows only. The design's count is kept as a quiet chip on each line of a person who got three or more emails today. Both count **only the rows that left** — sent, or refused by the person's server after it left — never one still waiting: three roles given in three presses queue three rows, held a few minutes after the last (§901), and the sending withdraws the two a later press made stale, so the person gets one email; counted while they wait, «Au primit același email de mai multe ori azi» would warn of what never arrives. A failed row reached nobody and counts for nobody. A test registration's row is marked «Test» and counted nowhere (AGENTS.md §12.6).
- **Who reads it:** the Administrator and the Superadministrator alone, asserted by the page on the server (`requireStaffCapability(canManageRegistrations)`, BR-REQ-060-01): it names people and addresses they already read on the list, in the exports and in the queue. The desk's roles, the Organizer and the Tehnic role are refused before a row is read; the links — the «Emailuri» tab, the queue panel's «Vezi ce a plecat azi», «Emailuri de trimis» on «Înscrieri» — are drawn only for the two roles.

**Slice 1: refused or left for later, and why.** The queue panel stays the reader of what waits for the club's verbs, and the page keeps «Așteaptă acum» as the build asked; the two share one judgement of each row's time (Critic correction 10 asked to fold the page into the panel instead). Zitadel's own emails are not in our queue and the page says so: listing them needs an audit row per Zitadel call in the staff presses (Critic correction 8), left for a later slice. A message withdrawn before it left is deleted to free its key and so is not listed; the page says that too. Saying a person's waiting rows apart in the warning («X au plecat, Y așteaptă») was left out: «Așteaptă acum» already lists them, by press. No other day (`?day=`) and no Organizer view.

**Slice 2 — the toast after the press says what it emailed.**

- **What the toast says.** After the act's own sentence, an emailing press's toast says what left — each email's type in the words of «Emailuri» —, to how many — the person the press acted on, the club's mailboxes, other people, test addresses counted apart — and when: «Înscrierea a fost anulată. Pleacă la 10:15 (estimat): „Înscriere anulată” către 1 persoană și 1 email pentru club. În plus, 1 email către altă persoană: „S-a eliberat un loc”.» The road the press's dialog chose (§841) is told inside the line («Pleacă acum prin Gmail-ul clubului: …»); outside an email press the bare «Pleacă prin …» stays as it was, and a press that queued nothing names no road.
- **Read from what the press really queued.** `flashOutcome` — the one call every emailing press's way back makes — and `withPressMail` (the participant message's and the import's own notice) read the press's rows back by `press_id` once its transaction committed (`notifications/press-receipt.ts`), so a row withdrawn inside the same press (the waiting-list email an offer replaced) is not told. The person's own email is a type the cause names as its main one (`press-causes.ts`); the club's side is a copy, the declaration's archive, «cineva a confirmat» and a notice to the club's people — a new order, a new volunteer (`email-audience.ts#isClubSide`, Critic correction 4: never «alte persoane»); the rest is other people; a test registration's row is counted apart and never among the people (AGENTS.md §12.6). The rows are read one by one rather than in the design's one aggregate query: each is judged by the queue's own `departureOf`, exactly, and a press's rows are the ones it inserted a moment before. A press that queued nothing costs one look by the press's index and adds nothing.
- **When — one judgement.** Each part's time is the queue panel's and «Emailuri azi»'s (`departureOf`, slice 1): now (a press's «Trimite acum», or the «imediat» timing's drain), at the estimated hour of the outbox job's run — a volunteer's roles email held two minutes for the next press included —, after Mailgun resumes while it is stopped and nothing carries the row, or over the next days for the part of a newsletter today's room past the reserve cannot hold (§445). A send split between two moments says both: «Pleacă acum: „Mesaj de la organizatori” către 40 de persoane; celelalte 5 pleacă la 10:30 (estimat).» (the participant message's «now» past what one press sends, §540, said until now by two sentences of its own). The context is read as the queue panel reads it, with the governor's floor taken from the level this instance last heard (`budget-level.ts`), never a request to Neon from inside a press. An hour, not «in N minutes»: it stays true when the toast is read a minute later, and it is the queue's own wording.
- **Nothing when nothing was queued.** The build asked it: a press that queued nothing says nothing about email — the design's «Nu a plecat niciun email.» was not built, since it would follow almost every editor save. So that no sentence can say «pus la coadă» when nothing was, every emailing press's `Feedback.toast` sentence that announced its email — «pus la coadă», «pleacă acum», «primește un email» — now says the act alone — «Înscrierea a fost anulată.», «Loc dat.», «Rol dat.», «Retrimis.», «Comanda a fost marcată plătită.», «Salvat; participanții sunt anunțați.» — and the mail line is the one place that says email. A bulk send that may reach nobody keeps its count as the act's («Mulțumiri pentru 0 participanți.», «Declarația retrimisă: 0 persoane.»), so a zero says zero; a volunteer with no address still reads «spune-i tu».
- **The roles' note says the rule as it stands.** Under a held roles email the toast adds «Dacă până atunci rolurile nu mai sunt aceleași, emailul se retrage.» — the withdrawal `render.ts` makes at the send (§837) — and not the design's «pleacă un singur email»: roles changed and changed back within the hold send two identical emails (Critic correction 6). Withdrawing a roles email whenever a newer one exists would make the promise true; it changes when an email leaves and amends §837's criterion, so it waits for the slice of rule changes.
- **Zitadel's own email.** Zitadel sends the password link itself, outside the club's queue: when an invitation to the team reached it, the toast adds «Zitadel trimite separat, acum, linkul pentru parolă.» When it did not — refused, no account, no key — the club's own invitation still left, and an info toast says «Contul Zitadel nu e gata: vezi mesajul de sus.» with what left and when (`invitedProviderFailed`, `reinvitedProviderFailed`, `membersInvitedProviderFailed`): never a green tick (§171, §288), and no toast at all when nothing was queued — the banner says why, as before.
- **What travels in the cookie.** The flash carries tokens, counts and instants — an email's type by its name in the code, how many, a departure word, the hours, the press's moment — never a name, an address or anything typed (§384's rule, amended from «only numbers»); the browser builds the sentence (`shared/feedback/mail-line.ts`) and checks every value first: a value the browser rewrote is no line. The type's words come with the backoffice's islands (`Admin.emails.types`, two kilobytes on pages only staff open). The dialog before the press (slice 3) is what names the person.
- **Short enough to read.** With the act's sentence the toast keeps to 200 characters (BR-REQ-060-01, Critic correction 9): past it the line gives up, in this order, other people's emails, the test addresses, the roles' note, the road, the club's count and Zitadel's note — what «Emailuri azi» lists anyway — and keeps what the person got and when. A toast with a mail line stays eight seconds, as the translate press's does.
- **The presses that toasted themselves.** «Trimite un mesaj participanților» flashes through `flashOutcome` now (its three sentences one, the split said by the line); an import over an event toasts only when its save emailed somebody; «Retrage și șterge invitațiile» on a person's page, which toasted nothing, says so and what its freed places sent. `tests/unit/shared/emailing-presses.test.ts` holds every emailing press to `flashOutcome` or `withPressMail`, never the bare `flash`.

**Slice 2: left for the next slices, and why.** Publishing, the deadlines' save and the editor save's job-sent emails (the alert to subscribers, «Anunță-mă», reminders and offers a moved window or a raised capacity sends at the next pass — Critic corrections 1 and 2) queue nothing in the press itself: they open no scope, and their «at the next pass of the job» lines go with slice 3's dialog lines, which read the same audiences. The design's «Ai debifat „Trimite emailul”» sentence is slice 4's opt-out.

**Slice 3 — before the press: every emailing press names its email first.**

- **One builder, one mechanism.** Every question an emailing press asks words its email line through one builder, `shared/feedback/confirm-words.ts`: `mail({ to, type, or, test, confirms, also })`, `mailCount` (counted from the ticks or the typed lines at the press), `noMail` / `noMailMany`. It names the person — on the desk by name only, never an address; a volunteer, a parent, a colleague and a shop member with the address where the page already shows it — or the count and whom («Pleacă 12 emailuri „Mulțumim după cursă”, câte unul către fiecare persoană marcată prezentă.»; «cel mult» when the press's outcome decides, or the lines typed are counted), and the email by its words in «Emailuri»; both emails when the outcome chooses between two («„Ești pe lista de așteptare” sau „Semnează declarația”, după cum iese apăsarea»). The mechanism stays one: `ActionForm`'s `confirm` and, where one form carries several verbs, `ConfirmSubmitButton`'s new `mail` prop, both drawing the one `ConfirmDialog` — which now draws, after the road, the quieter lines (`ConfirmSpec.also`, each with its own `when`). The contract gains `FormCondition.raisedFrom` (a box raised above a number, or emptied to unlimited) and `anyOf`, `EmailCount.lines` (the distinct lines of a typed list) and `club`, and `fillFrom` now fills the email line and the quieter lines too («Pleacă 1 email către {firstName} {lastName}…» for a person typed into the staff entry).
- **The club's copies: said, as one quiet count, never the addresses** (the owner asked about every email; copies spend the allowance). «Și 2 emailuri pentru căsuțele clubului.» is counted exactly as the enqueue makes them (`shared/feedback/club-copies-request.ts`, one read of the club's setting per page): the per-message Bcc of a participant's email (§320), the declaration's archive and «cineva a confirmat» on a confirmation (§244, §245), one copy per send for the organizer's message, the update notice, the newsletter and the new-event alert (§419, §445) — one per date for a series. A read that fails leaves the line out, never the page. «Emailuri azi» lists the addresses.
- **The road is the email's own.** The road line (§841) is derived from the email the line names (`emailGroupOf`), and drawn only when every email the press may send takes it — which ends the mismatches the map found: «Dă-i un loc acum» and the special guests' seat offered the confirmations' road for the links' declaration, the waiting-list entry and «Retrimite familiei» the clicked row's. «Retrimite familiei» now names the email the service sends, chosen by one pure rule both share (`registrations/domain/resend.ts#familyResendTarget`, `familyResendTypes`).
- **A test registration** (§30): its line names the person and the email and says «Adresa e de test (@test.invalid): emailul nu ajunge la nimeni, dar se numără în limita zilei.» in place of the club's count — where §384 dropped the line, a test row's question no longer promises nothing while the email still leaves; no count the club is given includes it.
- **A press that writes to nobody says so.** «Nu pleacă niciun email către Ana Pop.» on an erase, a withdrawn invitation, the person page's «Retrage și șterge invitațiile», a paper record with no address; «Persoanele șterse nu primesc niciun email.» on the bulk erase — with, where a counted place is freed, «Locul eliberat se oferă primului de pe lista de așteptare — îi pleacă „S-a eliberat un loc” — sau rămâne liber, după setarea evenimentului.»: said only for a row that held a counted place, and carrying BR-REQ-037-03 criterion 10's sentence for the cancellations, whose bodies now keep only the reason and «Nu se poate desface».
- **A question, or a line beside the button, as the design decided per kind.** A question where a press sends at once and could be doubled, or reaches many: the volunteer agreement's link and the parent's — each naming the address and the link sent before that the new one replaces —, «Trimite invitațiile» to volunteers (at most one email per line typed, the service skipping an open invitation), reopening a cancelled volunteer who holds roles and has an address («Confirmă» / «Înapoi la înscris», the only state presses that email), and the editor's save when it offers places or moves the declarations' deadlines. A `MailLine` (`shared/feedback/MailLine.tsx`, words `Admin.mailLine`) beside the button, costing no click, where presses come quickly one after another or sit in a data-entry form: a volunteer's role buttons (one line for the person's whole block of roles), «Adaugă voluntarul» and «Salvează» on a volunteer, «Adaugă înscrieri de test», the typed-name erase, the editor's «Număr de locuri», «Fereastra de confirmare», «Înscrierile se deschid în curând» and reminder boxes, and the import's differences screen (its lines from the keys the diff changes). The roles' line says the withdrawal rule as it stands — «Se retrage dacă rolurile se schimbă între timp.» —, never «un singur email» (Critic correction 6).
- **The editor's save** (Critic corrections 2 and 3). «Salvezi și oferi locurile noi?» asks when the posted «Locurile din lista de așteptare se alocă automat» is «Da» — read from the form, never the stored value — and the capacity is raised, emptied, or the offers switched on while people wait: «Pleacă cel mult N emailuri „S-a eliberat un loc”, câte unul către primii de pe lista de așteptare.» «Salvezi și muți termenele declarațiilor?» asks, while the window is open — before it opens a move sends nothing, the window's own ask says the new deadline on its day —, when a save moves the deadline of places held for the declaration (`moveWindowHolds`): at every save for places held to another instant, and when any of the window's two boxes or the start's day and hour changes for the rest; «cel mult»: an email still waiting, or one gone within the hour for a later deadline, is not sent again. A save that asks already — the cancellation, the notice — carries what it sends besides as quieter lines, in the order cancel > notice > offers > window. A cancelled event's save moves no hold and offers no place.
- **What the job sends after a press** (Critic correction 1). The publication's question says how many subscribers the job's next pass announces the event to, by the job's own rule (`newsletter/service.ts#previewEventAlertAudience`: `eventAlertWanted`, its topics, one a day at most); «Creează și publică» and the bulk publish say it without a count. The deadlines' save says the next pass sends what the new leads bring within reach — a reminder, a last call or a «Vii?» earlier, the address confirmation's resends in the new rhythm. The queue panel's switch to «imediat» says how many waiting emails leave at once, as «Trimite acum» does.
- **The shop.** «Marchează plătită» no longer promises the member an email when their account is gone or the shop's switch is off; a shop manager who may not read members' addresses (§550) reads the name alone. «Adaugă o comandă pentru un membru» asks by its two ticks: «Comanda ta a fost primită», then «Comanda ta e plătită», or no email.
- **Held by a guard.** `tests/unit/shared/emailing-presses.test.ts` follows every posting of every emailing press — `action` / `formAction`, through the props a page hands it down under (`offerAction`, `waitlistAddAction`, `sendAction`, …) — and fails one whose question carries no email line from the builder, holds no `ConfirmSubmitButton` with one and no `MailLine`; only the role buttons may say theirs in a line beside rather than inside, and the import's island before its call. No page pairs a road by hand any more. `confirmed-actions.test.ts` now holds the agreement link, the parent's link, the volunteer invitations and the state press to asking.

**Slice 3: left for slice 4, and why.** The opt-out — «Trimite emailul» in the dialog and beside the button (`ConfirmSpec.emailOptOut`, `sendEmailOf`), the design's choice 3 — waits for its own slice with the services' `sendEmail` option, its audit and its SPECS amendments: a box drawn before the server honours it would let the owner untick an email that still leaves. The role block's one-form restructure, which only that box needs, waits with it. A question rather than a line before the role buttons, the volunteer form, the test registrations, the typed-name erase and the opening (Critic correction 7) stays the owner's question; the design's per-kind choice is built. Withdrawing a roles email whenever a newer one exists (Critic correction 6) is a rule change, for slice 4. The deadlines' save and the import over an event say what the job may send without counts: a forecast per changed lead is not built. The presses that queue nothing of their own keep their questions: «Trimite acum» counts what leaves without listing it by type, the roads' save says nothing of the rows waiting for Mailgun's reset, and «Reîncearcă emailurile eșuate» counts what goes back without its types.

**Slice 4 — «Trimite emailul»: the person's own email may stay unsent where that is sensible** (the owner's choice 3).

- **One field, one parser.** The box posts `sendEmail`: in a question, a hidden input drawn `on` that the answer sets to `on` or `off` (`ConfirmSpec.emailOptOut`, worded by the builder's `optOut`; ticked again whenever a question opens); beside a button, the box itself followed by a hidden `off` under the same name (`MailLine`'s `optOut`), so an unticked box still says so. One parser reads it, `shared/forms/send-email.ts#sendEmailOf`: no value, or `on` among the values, sends — the box only ever takes an email away, never adds one, and a form without JavaScript, which asks nothing, sends. A press let through unasked, or answered by a question without the box, resets every box of its form to `on`: an earlier press's untick never rides along. The editor's window box has its own field, `sendEmail.window`.
- **What it reaches.** The action hands the box to its service as an explicit `sendEmail` option, which reaches the enqueue of the person's own message alone: false queues that row and so none of its club copies. It never keeps back what the press sends anybody else — the freed place's offer to the first in line, the declaration's archive, a notice to the club —, nor the club's refusal under the terms (§618), whose email states its ground: the cancel question offers no box while «Clubul refuză înscrierea» is ticked and says why, and the service refuses the pair as `REFUSAL_NEEDS_EMAIL`, naming the refusal's box.
- **The presses, ticked by default** — exactly the design's list, held by `OPT_OUT_PRESSES` in `emailing-presses.test.ts`, which fails any other action that reads the box: «Salvează nr.» on the desk and on the registration's page (`BIB_ASSIGNED`); «Anulează înscrierea» on the page and the list's ⋮, and one box for the bulk cancel's batch (`REGISTRATION_CANCELLED`); a volunteer's roles block — now one form, so its one box beside the buttons reaches «Dă-i rolul …», «Dă-i alt rol» (the select's role, `otherRoleId`) and «Ia-i rolul …» (its button's `formAction`, the role bound to it) —, «Adaugă voluntarul» and «Salvează» on a volunteer, and «Confirmă» / «Înapoi la înscris» on a cancelled person who holds roles (`VOLUNTEER_ROLE_ASSIGNED`); «Semnat pe hârtie» for the parent's consent (the volunteer's second copy of their agreement — their first, of what they signed, reached them when they accepted); «Adaugă» on «Echipa» («Trimite invitația acum») and «Adaugă membrii» («Trimite invitațiile acum»): unticked, the row is added, no invitation is queued and Zitadel is not asked — «Retrimite invitația» later sends both, making the Zitadel account when it is missing (`zitadel-users.ts#reinviteZitadelUser`); «Marchează plătită» (`SHOP_ORDER_PAID`); the editor's «Trimite din nou „Semnează declarația”» beside «Fereastra de confirmare»; and «Publică», «Creează și publică» and the bulk publish («Anunță abonații newsletterului»).
- **No box where the email is the point** — a resend, an offer, «Dă-i un loc acum», the special guests, the waiting-list and internal-list moves, a declaration to sign, an invitation to an event, the newsletter, the thank-you, the organizers' message, the agreement's and the parent's links, the volunteer invitations — **nor on the copy of a document the person signed**: the desk's paper confirmation (with «Dă-i un loc» and the staff entry's fast track) and the volunteer's paper contract are the person's only copy of what they signed (BR-REQ-033-02 criterion 9, §758). That was the design's one question for the owner; it is built as the design recommended.
- **The window's box keeps back only what would not come back** (Critic correction 3). When the move's email goes under the job's own key — the new deadline's last call due within the hour, or the window's own ask still owed — keeping it back would only leave the key free for the job's next pass, which would send the same email: it goes whatever the box says. So the box keeps back a deadline moved later under the move's own key (`window-holds.ts#windowEmailSkippable`) — the email the person has states an earlier deadline, still safe to act on —, and a deadline moved earlier is always told. It is offered only while a move sends (the window open, the event not cancelled), its line saying what it keeps back; the save's questions keep «cel mult» either way and add a line while it is unticked; the banner says who was not sent it again, and `event.holds_moved_by_window` how many.
- **The publication's box** marks the event seen for the new-event alert — the `newsletter_sends` `EVENT_ALERT` row with no recipients that the job already writes for an event nobody would hear of, which it skips ever after and «Trimise» already hides — in the publication's own transaction (`newsletter/alert-skip.ts`), so the job never finds the event live and unmarked; no new column. The editor's «Publică» offers it only while an alert would go (`previewEventAlertAudience`); «Creează și publică» and the bulk publish always.
- **The trail.** The press's own audit row says `emailSkipped: true` — `registration.bib_set`, `registration.cancelled_by_staff`, `volunteer.added`, `.assigned`, `.unassigned`, `.edited` and `.state_changed` (only when the change would have emailed), `volunteer.guardian_recorded` (only when a copy would have left), `shop.order.paid` (only when the email would have left: the shop writing to members and the order's account there), `staff.members_invited`, `event.holds_moved_by_window` (with how many, `skipped`) —, and the two presses with no row of their own write one, only when skipped: `staff.invitation_not_sent` (the row and the message, never an address) and `event.new_event_alert_skipped`.
- **After the press.** The toast says what the press chose not to send, first, counted — «1 email nu a plecat: ai debifat „Trimite…”.», after a bulk press «3 emailuri nu au plecat …» — then what still left, the offer to the next in line; a publication's toast ends with «Abonații newsletterului primesc anunțul la următoarea trecere a jobului.» or «… nu primesc anunțul: ai debifat caseta.» (`mailSkipped`, `mailAlert`: a count and a word in the cookie, never a name). «Echipa»'s banner says nobody was written to and Zitadel was not asked, and the members' banner no longer says «Invitațiile sunt pe drum» when none is.

**Slice 4: left out, and why.** The design's end-to-end walk (`email-before-after.spec.ts`) is not written: no Playwright run was allowed on the shared machine this round ran on, and a spec never run would be a red shard; the services' integration tests (`registrations/email-opt-out.test.ts` and the slice-4 cases of the volunteers', publication's, shop's and window's suites) and the guard hold the behaviour. Withdrawing a roles email whenever a newer one exists (Critic correction 6) is still not built: the box lets the organizer keep a press quiet, and a held roles email is withdrawn at the send once its roles no longer stand, as before. Zitadel's own emails are still not in «Emailuri azi» (Critic correction 8).

**The review round (2026-11-04).** The notice's and the offers' questions now count the window's re-sent declarations as the window's own question does: «cel mult» both kinds of held places once any of the window's four boxes moved, the places held to another instant alone while none did — no longer the first kind alone (`content/events/save-mail.ts#windowMailLines`; unit-tested: two held elsewhere, three at the window, the window moved — «cel mult 5»); the offers' line brings its club count into the notice's question too. «Confirmă pe hârtie» on a row the allocator may still put on the waiting list — an address never confirmed, or from the event's start a place still waiting for its declaration — and the staff entry's fast track say «— sau niciunul, dacă intră pe lista de așteptare», with the club's count «cel mult» (`registrations/domain/row-verbs.ts#mayEndWaitlisted`); a place held before the start, and an offer, keep the certain line. «Retrimite invitația» outside Zitadel's provider mode toasts the act, as «Adaugă» does, never «Linkul Zitadel nu a plecat». The editor's notice toasts count no email (the mail line does); the orphan audiences «confirmed» and «newAddresses» are gone.

**The second review round (2026-11-04).** A volunteer's roles block, one form since slice 4, opens with a hidden default of its own: Enter on its «Trimite emailul» box or on «Dă-i alt rol»'s select submits the form through its first submit button, which was the first «Ia-i rolul …», and took a role away. The default posts nowhere, with or without JavaScript — a string `formAction`, which React leaves to the browser, and `formMethod="dialog"`, a submission the browser drops outside a `<dialog>` —, and is never `disabled`: on a box's Enter, Chrome and Safari skip a disabled default and press the next submit button. The house's other hidden defaults (the results table, the FAQ) save, their form's one verb; this form has no harmless verb to press. The same pass found «Ia-i rolul …» posting no role at all: React writes its own name on a button whose `formAction` is a Server Action and posts neither its name nor its value, so the button's `roleId` never left. The role is now bound to the action (`unassignVolunteerAction.bind(null, role.id)`; the action takes `(roleId, form)`), and the service reads it like any posted value — not a role id is refused, a role the person does not hold changes nothing. In the tests the person's form is `volunteer-person-roles`, apart from the event's roles panel (`volunteer-roles`).

`shop.order.paid` says `emailSkipped` only when «Comanda ta e plătită» would have left ticked — the shop writing to members (§704) and the order's account there (`orders.ts#paidEmailWouldLeave`). `mailSkipped` carries how many emails the box kept back — one for a press on one person, the real rows of a bulk cancel (test rows are counted nowhere the club is told, §30), the members added — and the toast says them in the number's own form («1 email nu a plecat …», «3 emailuri …», «21 de emailuri …»; nothing for none), every form with its count as the catalogue's counted words are. `reinviteZitadelUser`'s fallback is unit-tested: no account found, it is made and invited; found, it is invited again and none is made; any other refusal comes back as it came.

Migration `0189_email_press`'s journal `when` moved past `0191_elite_visibility`'s (#653): drizzle applies a migration only when its `when` is later than the last one applied, so an earlier `when` would be skipped once 0191 ran. 0191 was not on `qa` when this round finished, so the entry keeps its index; the merge after #653 moves it after 0191 and chains its snapshot to 0191's.
changelogLine: - **«Emailuri azi», every press's email before and after, and «Trimite emailul»** — every staff press that can send an email now stamps its rows with what was pressed, by whom and one id per press; «Setări» → «Emailuri» → «Emailuri azi» lists the day's emails with the names, what waits and what left, by press, and who got the same email twice — for the Administrator and the Superadministrator; before the press, its question — or, for a volunteer's role buttons and the forms where presses come quickly, a line beside the button — names the person or how many, the email, how many copies go to the club's mailboxes and the road it takes, and the volunteer agreement's link, the parent's link, the volunteer invitations and the editor's save that offers places now ask first; the toast after it says what left, to how many — the person, the club, other people — and when: now, at the estimated hour, or after Mailgun resumes; and where it is sensible — a race number given by hand, a cancellation, a volunteer's roles, the parent's paper consent, an invitation to the team, a shop order paid, the declaration re-sent for a deadline moved later, a publication's alert to the subscribers — a «Trimite emailul» box, ticked by default, lets the person's own email stay unsent, on the audit trail, while the offer to the next in line and the club's archive still go. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given a staff press that queues email, when its rows are committed, then every one of them — the person's message, the club's copies of it, a bulk send's one copy, an offer to the next in line — carries the press's cause, one press id shared by all of them and the staff member who pressed as its requester (a requester the service names wins); the two job routes and the drains after a response stamp the job's cause and their own run's id; a row a public flow queues carries none; and the stamp never changes whether or when a row leaves (2026-11-04, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given «Setări» → «Emailuri» → «Emailuri azi», then it lists every email of the club's day — left since midnight on the club's clock, waiting from any day, failed or refused today — with the person's name and address, «Așteaptă acum» before «Au plecat azi», one row per press with its moment, its cause and who pressed; a club mailbox's row folds under the message it copies or its press and is never counted as a person; the same email sent to the same person twice or more today, by the canonical address, on the person's own mail only and counting only the rows that left — never one still waiting, which the sending may yet withdraw — is listed at the top, and a person's day on their lines counts the same rows; and a test registration's row is marked and left out of every count (2026-11-04, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Amends criterion 23. Given a waiting row on the queue panel or «Emailuri azi», then its departure is one judgement for both: «Pleacă după ce Mailgun reia» with the hour while Mailgun is stopped and nothing carries a Mailgun-road row, or a Free plan's day is spent — under the «imediat» timing too, whose drain claims no such row; «Pleacă acum» while the «imediat» timing's drain is still sending a row queued a moment ago and never tried, on a road open to it, and for a press's own «Trimite acum»; the late mark is unchanged (2026-11-04, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given «Emailuri azi», when anyone but an Administrator or a Superadministrator opens it — a desk role, the Organizer, the Tehnic role — then the page refuses on the server before it reads a row, and its links on the «Emailuri» tab, the queue panel and «Emailuri de trimis» are drawn only for the two roles (2026-11-04, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a staff press that queued email, when its toast shows, then after the act's own sentence it says what left — each type in the words of «Emailuri» —, to how many — the people the press acted on, the club's mailboxes (a copy, the declaration's archive, «cineva a confirmat», a notice to the club's people), other people, test addresses counted apart — and when: now, at the estimated hour by the queue's own judgement (a volunteer's roles email held for the next press included, with its note), after Mailgun resumes, or over the next days for a newsletter past today's room, a send split between two moments saying both; with the road the press's dialog chose; read from the rows the press committed, so a row withdrawn in the same press is not told; a press that queued nothing says nothing about email, and the press's own toast sentence no longer says that an email was queued or when it leaves — the mail line alone does (2026-11-04, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Amends criterion 23. Given a backoffice toast's cookie, then it carries numbers and, for an emailing press, an email type by its name in the code, a departure word and its instants — never a name, an address or anything typed — and the browser checks each value before it says it (2026-11-04, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Amends criterion 97. Given a toast with its mail line, then the whole sentence keeps to 200 characters: the line drops other people's emails, the test addresses, the roles' note, the road, the club's count and Zitadel's note, in that order, and keeps what the person got and when (2026-11-04, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given an invitation to the team, a re-invitation or members added, when Zitadel refused, found no account or was never asked and the club's own invitation email was still queued, then an info toast says the account is not ready and what the club's email was and when — never a green tick; with nothing queued there is no toast and the banner says why; and when Zitadel invited the person, the toast names Zitadel's own password email beside the club's (2026-11-04, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a staff press that can send an email, when its form is drawn, then before the press it names the email: its question's email line, worded by one builder, names the person by name — on the desk never an address; a volunteer, a parent, a colleague or a shop member with the address only where the page already shows it — or how many and whom («cel mult» when the outcome decides or typed lines are counted), the email by its words in «Emailuri» (both, when the outcome chooses between two), the club's mailboxes as one quiet count made as the enqueue makes them and never their addresses, and the road the email itself takes (none when two possible emails take different roads); a confirmation the allocator may still turn into a place on the waiting list — «Confirmă pe hârtie» on an address never confirmed, or from the event's start on a place still waiting for its declaration, and the staff entry's fast track — names its email «or none», with the club's count «cel mult»; a press that writes to nobody it acts on says so; a test registration's line says its address reaches nobody, in place of the club's count; and the presses that come quickly one after another or sit in a data-entry form — a volunteer's role buttons and form, the test registrations, the typed-name erase, the editor's boxes whose change sends at the job's pass, the import's differences — say it in a line beside the button, in the same words, costing no click. Verification: `tests/unit/shared/emailing-presses.test.ts` follows every posting of every emailing press, through the props it is handed down under, and fails one that says nothing (2026-11-04, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a volunteer, when the organizer presses «Trimite linkul contractului», «Trimite linkul părintelui», «Trimite invitațiile», or «Confirmă» / «Înapoi la înscris» on a cancelled person who holds roles and has an address, then a question asks first, naming the person (or the parent) with the address and the email, the link sent before that the new one replaces, and at most one invitation per line typed; the paper agreement's and the parent's paper's questions name the copy that leaves, or that none does; and the role buttons, «Adaugă voluntarul» and «Salvează» carry a line naming the roles' email, its few minutes' hold and its withdrawal when the roles change again — or that a person with no address is sent nothing (2026-11-04, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given the event editor, when a save would offer places — «Locurile din lista de așteptare se alocă automat» posted «Da» with the capacity raised or emptied, or the offers switched on, while people wait — or, while the declaration window is open, move the deadline of places held, then it asks first, naming at most how many «S-a eliberat un loc» or «Semnează declarația» leave, and a save that asks already for its notice or its cancellation carries them as quieter lines, counted as their own questions count them — the offers with their club count, and the declarations «cel mult» the places held to another instant plus, once any of the window's four boxes moved, those held to the window's own instant (two and three: «cel mult 5»), the first alone while none moved; a publication's question says how many subscribers the job's next pass announces the event to, by the job's own rule, and the deadlines' save says the next pass sends what the new leads bring (2026-11-04, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Amends criterion 26. Given a question for an action that queues email, when it opens, then its email line is the one builder's — «Pleacă N emailuri „<the email>”, câte unul către fiecare participant.», or the person by name — in place of "An email will be sent to N participants"; N is still read with the send's own query and counts real registrations only, summed over the dates ticked of a series and the rows ticked of the bulk cancel, and a count of 0 still says nothing; a press that writes to nobody it acts on now says so («Nu pleacă niciun email către …»); and a test registration's question names the person and the email and says its address reaches nobody, in place of the club's count (2026-11-04, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Amends criterion 10. Given a dialog that cancels a registration by staff, one or in bulk, then the email line names the person — or counts the people ticked — and «Înscriere anulată», the body says the written reason stays in the journal and is sent only with the refusal under the terms, and the quieter line says the freed place is offered to the first in line, with «S-a eliberat un loc», or stays free by the event's setting — said for a row that held a counted place, and for every place a bulk cancel frees (2026-11-04, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a staff press that offers «Trimite emailul» — «Salvează nr.», «Anulează înscrierea» (one, from the list's ⋮ or in bulk), a volunteer's roles block, «Adaugă voluntarul», «Salvează» on a volunteer and the reopening of a cancelled one with roles, «Semnat pe hârtie» for a parent's consent, «Adaugă» and «Adaugă membrii» on «Echipa», «Marchează plătită», the editor's window box and the three publications —, then the box is ticked whenever it is drawn, one parser reads it (`sendEmailOf`: no value, or «on» among the values, sends), and with it unticked the press does all it does ticked, queues no message of the person it acts on — nor that message's club copies — and writes `emailSkipped: true` on its own audit row (`staff.invitation_not_sent` and `event.new_event_alert_skipped` where the press has none), while the freed place's offer to the first in line, the declaration's archive and the club's notices still go; no other action reads the box — never a resend, an offer, a declaration to sign, a link, an invitation to an event, the newsletter, a thank-you, the organizers' message, the desk's paper confirmation or the volunteer's paper contract; and the toast says the email did not go — after a bulk press how many, in the number's own form —, then what else left. Verification: `tests/unit/shared/send-email.test.ts`, `tests/unit/shared/emailing-presses.test.ts` (`OPT_OUT_PRESSES`), `tests/integration/registrations/email-opt-out.test.ts` (2026-11-04, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Amends criteria 7 and 11. Given a race number given or changed by hand on a confirmed registration, when «Trimite emailul» is unticked in its question, then the number is written and audited as ever, the audit row says `emailSkipped`, and no `BIB_ASSIGNED` is queued: the runner is not told by email; ticked, the number, the QR code and the manage link go as before (2026-11-04, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Amends criterion 10. Given a staff cancellation — the registration's page, the list's ⋮ or the bulk cancel's one box for the batch —, when «Trimite emailul» is unticked, then the registration is cancelled through the allocator as ever, no «Înscriere anulată» is queued, the audit row says `emailSkipped`, and the freed place is still offered to the first in line with «S-a eliberat un loc», or kept free, by the event's setting; while «Clubul refuză înscrierea» is ticked the question offers no box and says the refusal always tells the person its ground, and a refusal posted with the box unticked is refused (`REFUSAL_NEEDS_EMAIL`, naming the refusal's box) with nothing cancelled (2026-11-04, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Amends criteria 43 and 47. Given a change of the roles given to a volunteer — «Dă-i rolul …», «Dă-i alt rol», «Ia-i rolul …», «Adaugă voluntarul» with roles given, «Salvează» changing the roles or the address, or «Confirmă» / «Înapoi la înscris» reopening a cancelled person with roles —, when the person's one «Trimite emailul» is unticked (beside the roles block, which is one form, beside the forms' buttons, or in the reopening's question), then the change is made and audited with `emailSkipped` and no `VOLUNTEER_ROLE_ASSIGNED` is queued; a roles email an earlier press queued is still withdrawn at the send once its roles no longer stand; and «Semnat pe hârtie» for a parent's consent with the box unticked records the consent and queues no second copy of the volunteer's agreement; Enter on the roles block's box or select presses nothing — the form's first submit button is a hidden default that posts nowhere, never «Ia-i rolul …» — and «Ia-i rolul …» takes the role it names, bound to its action. Verification: `tests/unit/volunteers/profile-render.test.ts`, `tests/integration/volunteers/card.test.ts` (2026-11-04, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Amends criteria 10 and 11. Given «Adaugă» on «Echipa» or «Adaugă membrii», when «Trimite invitația acum» (or «Trimite invitațiile acum») is unticked in the question, then the rows are added, no `STAFF_INVITATION` or `MEMBER_INVITATION` is queued, Zitadel is not asked for an account, one `staff.invitation_not_sent` audit row per person added alone (by id and message, never an address) or `emailSkipped` on `staff.members_invited` says so, and the banner says nobody was written to; «Retrimite invitația» later queues the invitation and makes the Zitadel account when it is missing — and only then: one that exists is invited again, any other refusal comes back as it came (`tests/unit/staff/zitadel-users.test.ts`); outside Zitadel's provider mode its toast says the act, as «Adaugă»'s does (2026-11-04, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Amends criterion 74. Given «Marchează plătită» on a member's order, when «Trimite emailul» is unticked in its question, then the order is marked paid, no «Comanda ta e plătită» is queued, and the payment's audit row says `emailSkipped` only when the email would have left — the shop writing to members and the order's account there; «Marchează predată» and «Anulează» offer no box and send nothing, as before (2026-11-04, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Amends criterion 16. Given an editor save that moves places held for the declaration inside an open window, when «Trimite din nou „Semnează declarația”» beside «Fereastra de confirmare» is unticked (`sendEmail.window`, offered only while a move sends), then every hold moves as ever, and only a hold whose deadline moved later and whose email would go under its own key `registration:<id>:deadline-moved:<instant>` is not sent `COMPLETE_DECLARATION` again; a deadline moved earlier, a move that is the new deadline's last call or the window's own ask still owed is sent whatever the box says; `event.holds_moved_by_window` says `emailSkipped` and how many, and the save's banner says who was not sent it again (2026-11-04, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a publication — «Publică» while an alert would go, «Creează și publică», or the bulk publish's one box —, when «Anunță abonații newsletterului» is unticked, then the event is published as ever and, in the publication's own transaction, marked seen for the new-event alert with a `newsletter_sends` `EVENT_ALERT` row of no recipients and one `event.new_event_alert_skipped` audit row, so the job never announces it; ticked, or by a caller that does not say, the job announces it at its next pass, one alert a day at most, and the toast says when — or that it will not (2026-11-04, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: every staff press's emails carry their press, «Emailuri azi» lists the day's emails by press, every press names its email before it is pressed, each press's toast says what it emailed and when, and «Trimite emailul» lets the person's own email stay unsent where sensible
